pages.text: The Nest produces nothing on its own. It exists to make Roosts faster.

pages.title: The Aura
pages.text: Put a $(l)rooster$() item and some $(l)seeds$() into the Nest. It consumes seeds to maintain a timed aura that boosts every Roost within range.$(br2)Run out of seeds and the aura lapses, so keep it fed if you rely on the bonus.
